headline: Bitcoin is holding near $80,000 as markets wait for Wednesday's Fed decision, while the NBA teamed up with the CFTC, Kalshi and Polymarket on prediction markets.

market.asOf: BTC, ETH and SOL read from CoinMarketCap's coin pages at about 19:57 UTC Mon 26 Oct (02:57 Tue Bangkok). Fear & Greed: alternative.me 50 (Neutral); CoinMarketCap's own index 44 (Neutral). Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 50, Neutral (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); CoinMarketCap's index reads 44, Neutral

stories.title: Bitcoin pinned near $80,000 into Fed week after late-week ETF outflows
stories.summary: Bitcoin dipped toward $79,000 in Asian trading on Monday and bounced back above $80,000. Money left the US spot bitcoin funds on Thursday and Friday. Markets expect the Fed to hold rates on Wednesday but to raise them in December.
points: Bitcoin dipped to $79,000 and recovered to $80,300; it is down 2.45% over 7 days, per FXStreet.

Spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) lost $635.6M on 22 Oct and $137.9M on 23 Oct, per Farside, but still ended the week about $301M positive, per Cointelegraph. FXStreet puts the week at +$104.6M.
Spot ether ETFs had a fourth straight week of outflows, about $221M, per Cointelegraph.
About $154M of leveraged crypto bets were force-closed in 24 hours, $118M of them bets on prices rising, per CoinGlass data reported by crypto.news.
The Fed decides Wednesday at 2pm ET with rates at 3.75-4.00%; markets price about a 90% chance of no change and about 80% for a December hike, per FXStreet.

stories.title: Corporate crypto buyers split: Strategy pauses while Strive and Bitmine keep buying
stories.summary: Strategy, the biggest corporate bitcoin holder, bought no bitcoin last week and spent about $205M buying back its own preferred shares instead. Smaller rivals kept buying: Strive added about $511M of bitcoin and Bitmine added more ether.
points: Strategy bought no bitcoin from 19 to 25 Oct; holdings stay at 848,517 BTC at an average cost of $75,446, per The Crypto Times.
It spent $204.9M buying back 2,068,459 STRC preferred shares, per The Crypto Times.
Strive bought 6,182 BTC for about $511M from 17 to 23 Oct, taking it to 43,000 BTC, per The Block.
Bitmine added 10,452 ETH for a total of 6,051,933 ETH, per The Block.
Strategy holds a special shareholder vote on Wednesday and reports earnings after the US close on Thursday.

stories.title: The NBA signs a pact with the CFTC and names Kalshi and Polymarket as partners
stories.summary: The NBA agreed to share information with the US futures regulator to protect the integrity of prediction markets, where people trade on the outcome of events. It named Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction market exchanges. The same day, Bernstein said prediction markets and derivatives will drive growth at Coinbase and Robinhood.
points: The NBA signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC and named Kalshi and Polymarket 'Preferred Prediction Market Exchanges', per the NBA.
League and team staff are banned from trading NBA event contracts, per the NBA.
Bernstein cut its Coinbase price target to $250 from $330 and kept its Outperform rating, per The Block.
Bernstein projects about $2B of Coinbase prediction-market and derivatives revenue and $1.7B of Robinhood prediction-market revenue by 2028, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kraken's parent plans regulated Hyperliquid futures for US clients
briefs.summary: Payward plans to be the first CFTC-regulated deployer of 'HIP-3' perpetual futures markets on Hyperliquid; there is no launch date and it still needs regulatory approval, per Crypto Briefing.

briefs.title: Keystone wallet breach: check devices bought after 20 Oct
briefs.summary: Keystone says 25,964 buyer records and a device authentication key were exposed but seed phrases and private keys were not; it will destroy 18,835 devices in stock, per The Crypto Times. Watch for fake 'recall' scams.

briefs.title: Crypto venues are already trading bets on Anthropic's IPO
briefs.summary: After Anthropic filed to list on Nasdaq, synthetic futures on Binance and Bitget implied a value near $1.9T; these are speculative contracts, not shares, per Bitcoin.com News.

briefs.title: Smaller holders are sending more bitcoin to Binance
briefs.summary: CryptoQuant data shows 30-day retail deposits to Binance rose from about $5.5B to $10.75B while whale deposits fell to about $3.8B, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Galaxy says the bitcoin bear market is over
briefs.summary: Galaxy Research says the bear market ended in June, noting five straight weekly closes above the 50-week average; it says the view is challenged by a weekly close below $76,540 that is not recovered within a month, per The Block.

briefs.title: Aviva puts a money market fund share class on the XRP Ledger
briefs.summary: Aviva Investors and Ripple launched a tokenized share class of Aviva's sterling money market fund, with Aviva putting in £50M, per The Block.

briefs.title: South Korea weighs a fourth delay to its crypto tax
briefs.summary: The tax, due 1 Jan 2027, could be pushed to 1 Jan 2029, per The Block.
